decisions: This repository is independent of build-a-web-page-for-ios.
Hardware target is original ESP32 integrated TWAI plus NXP TJA1051T/3 SO8.
Default runtime state must be passive/listen-only with a hardware-enforced transmitter inhibit.
Vehicle CAN identifiers and signal mappings remain unknown until supported by evidence.
The initial baseline contains project specifications only, not application firmware or a completed schematic.
open_questions: Exact ESP32 module/board and accessible GPIOs
Available Proteus version, Python automation path, and official symbol/library availability
Verified bus bit rate(s), topology, and safely available capture points for the target vehicle
